lines: As far as what has been stated — direct
for someone's attainment-of-release; as-summary-manner
it stands for someone, from the application's coming
in the to-be-told initiation:
so initiation-and-rest is to be told.
sanskrit_cite: tatra yāvat idam uktam tat sākṣāt kasyacit apavargāptaye yathoktasaṃgrahanītyā bhavati kasyacit vakṣyamāṇadīkṣāyām upayogagamanāt iti dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam

lines: The question of qualification opens: it is the power-descent that gets examined.
sanskrit_cite: tatra kaḥ adhikārī iti nirūpaṇārthaṃ śaktipāto vicāryate

lines: Some there say: knowledge absent, ignorance roots saṃsāra; from its going, knowledge-rise — that is descent. To their claim: knowledge-alone is the distortion.
Act-born behaves like act-fruit; in enjoyment and enjoyer both, the two possibilities are over-reach.
Will-caused, the knowledge-rise leans on itself in vain; in the Lord, passion's issue follows.
Equal contradictory acts block each other — act-parity, they say, then descent? Not so: sequence forbids clash; where acts do not clash, enjoyment issues, but non-occurrence brings body-death.
Birth-and-lifespan giving stays unobstructed; only enjoyment-giving is bound — and if power fell on that, what fear would the enjoyer have?
sanskrit_cite: tatra kecit āhuḥ jñānābhāvāt ajñānamūlaḥ saṃsāraḥ tadapagame jñānodayāt śaktipāta iti teṣāṃ samyak jñānodaya eva vikṛta iti vācyam karmajanyatve karmaphalavat bhogatvaprasaṅge bhogini ca śaktipātābhyupagatau atiprasaṅgaḥ īśvarecchānimittatve tu jñānodayasya anyonyāśrayatā vaiyarthyaṃ ca īśvare rāgādiprasaṅgaḥ viruddhayoḥ karmaṇoḥ samabalayoḥ anyonyapratibandhe karmasāmyaṃ tataḥ śaktipāta iti cet na kramikatve virodhāyogāt virodhe 'pi anyasya aviruddhasya karmaṇo bhogadānaprasaṅgāt aviruddhakarmāpravṛttau tadaiva dehapātaprasaṅgāt jātyāyuṣpradaṃ karma na pratibadhyate bhogapradam eva tu pratibadhyate iti cet kutaḥ tatkarmasadbhāve yadi śaktiḥ patet tarhi sā bhogapradāt kiṃ bibhiyāt

lines: Now, in ripened impurity: what shape has the descent, and what marks it?
By this the difference-doctrine counters collapse — dispassion, special-duty, discernment, true-service, true-attainment, god-worship, and the rest as reasons.
sanskrit_cite: atha malaparipāke śaktipātaḥ so 'pi kiṃsvarūpaḥ kiṃ ca tasya nimittam iti etena vairāgyaṃ dharmaviśeṣo vivekaḥ satsevā satprāptiḥ devapūjā ityādihetuḥ pratyukta iti bhedavādināṃ sarvam asamañjasam

lines: Within the free-Lord's two-inseparable doctrine it stands: the Supreme-Lord, by self-covering sport, becomes cattle-being, individual, atom — with no place-time-form-clash of him.
By withdrawal of self-hiding, self-recovery — sudden or staged, taking refuge — makes the atom a vessel for descent.
Made of freedom alone, this Supreme-Śiva is the causer of power's fall: independent, bearing self-manifestation as fruit.
But the enjoyment-eager one's is act-tied; the supernatural-eager's — that very one is descent.
Māyā-womb-qualified through Rudra-Viṣṇu-Brahmā's door, mantra-form-ness, the four vivekas, and other fruits — these bind lower-tattva-bhoga.
Both-eager: tied in enjoyment, free in release — tied and untied at once.
sanskrit_cite: svatantraparameśādvayavāde tu upapadyate etat yathāhi parameśvaraḥ svarūpācchādanakrīḍayā paśuḥ pudgalo 'ṇuḥ sampannaḥ na ca tasya deśakālasvarūpabhedavirodhaḥ tadvat svarūpasthaganavinivṛttyā svarūpapratyāpattiṃ jhaṭiti vā krameṇa vā samāśrayan śaktipātapātram aṇuḥ ucyate svātantryamātrasāraś ca asau paramaśivaḥ śakteḥ pātayitā iti nirapekṣa eva śaktipāto yaḥ svarūpaprathāphalaḥ yas tu bhogotsukasya sa karmāpekṣaḥ lokottararūpabhogotsukasya tu sa eva śaktipātaḥ parameśvarecchāpreritamāyāgarbhādhikārīyarudraviṣṇubrahmādidvāreṇa mantrādirūpatvaṃ māyāpuṃvivekaṃ puṃskalāvivekaṃ puṃprakṛtivivekaṃ puṃbuddhivivekam anyac ca phalaṃ prasnuvānaḥ tadadharatattvabhogaṃ pratibadhnāti bhogamokṣobhayotsukasya bhoge karmāpekṣo mokṣe tu tannirapekṣaḥ iti sāpekṣanirapekṣaḥ

lines: Nor is it to-be-said in-someone-just man descent:
he just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines.
In-being-truth: who is this man, by-name —
that in-purport object-made impulse, this.
sanskrit_cite: na ca vācyaṃ kasmāt kasmiṃścid eva puṃsi śaktipāta iti sa eva parameśvaraḥ tathā bhāti iti satattve ko 'sau pumān nāma yaduddeśena viṣayakṛtā codanā iyam

lines: And this power-descent ninefold in intense-middle-mild,
by-superiority-equality-inferiority; again triplicity.
From superior-intense: Supremeness just-then in-body-death;
from middle-intense, one-independent-of-scripture-teacher,
of-own-conviction, intuitive-knowledge-arising —
in-which-arising outer-consecration without-alone
giving-enjoyment-and-release, intuitive teacher, thus said.
For his no-conception-of-samayya-and-rest-any,
even-herein degree-existence from-wills-manifoldness —
thus, being-even in-intuitive-ness, dependence
on-scripture-and-rest would-be for-agreement — even.
So the teacher's many fissures and walls, in scripts, is told;
and of-intuitive-one in-scriptures is-said;
in any case, the intuitive part stands stronger in its presence — others, from unqualification.
of-others from-unqualification.
sanskrit_cite: sa cāyaṃ śaktipāto navadhā tīvramadhyamandasya utkarṣamādhyasthyanikarṣaiḥ punas traividhyāt tatra utkṛṣṭatīvrāt tadaiva dehapāte parameśatā madhyatīvrāt śāstrācāryānapekṣiṇaḥ svapratyayasya prātibhajñānodayaḥ yadudaye bāhyasaṃskāraṃ vinaiva bhogāpavargapradaḥ prātibho gurur ity ucyate tasya hi na samayyādikalpanā kācit atrāpi tāratamyasadbhāvaḥ icchāvaicitryāt iti saty api prātibhatve śāstrādyapekṣā saṃvādāya syād api iti nirbhittisabhittyādibahubhedatvam ācāryasya prātibhasyāgameṣu uktam sarvathā pratibhāṃśo balīyān tatsaṃnidhau anyeṣām anadhikārāt

lines: Like difference-view before eternal Śiva, among liberated-Śivas at creation-dissolution-work: from mild-intense descent, longing for a good guru arises; in a bad guru, only concealment; from bad-guru-ness, the good-guru-way comes by descent itself.
sanskrit_cite: bhedadarśana iva anādiśivasaṃnidhau muktaśivānāṃ sṛṣṭilayādikṛtyeṣu mandatīvrāt śaktipātāt sadguruviṣayā yiyāsā bhavati asadguruviṣayāyāṃ tu tirobhāva eva asadgurutas tu sadgurugamanaṃ śaktipātād eva

lines: Good-guru is full-of-all-this-scripture-truth-knowledge,
directly Bhagavan-Bhairava-Bhattacharya — indeed
of-yogis-even by-own-studied-knowledge in-freeness-giving;
therein of-qualifiability like-good-fortune-beauty-possession
from-non-application.
sanskrit_cite: sadgurus tu samastaitacchāstratattvajñānapūrṇaḥ sākṣāt bhagavadbhairavabhaṭṭāraka eva yogino 'pi svabhyastajñānatayaiva mocakatve tatra yogyatvasya saubhāgyalāvaṇyādimattvasyevānupayogāt

lines: The bad guru: every other —
all just.
sanskrit_cite: asadgurus tu anyaḥ sarva eva

lines: The longing one thereby gains the guru's knowledge-initiation — by it at once freed, even living here.
Its kinds: seeing, telling, scripture-teaching, conduct-showing, charity-giving, and the rest.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yiyāsuḥ guroḥ jñānalakṣaṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpnoti yayā sadya eva mukto bhavati jīvann api atra avalokanāt kathanāt śāstrasambodhanāt caryādarśanāt carudānāt ityādayo bhedāḥ

lines: For the practitioner, or just then, at once the life-releasing initiation is gained; but she is to be done at death's moment alone — so it is told.
sanskrit_cite: abhyāsavato vā tadānīṃ sadya eva prāṇaviyojikāṃ dīkṣāṃ labhate sā tu maraṇakṣaṇa eva kāryā iti vakṣyāma iti

lines: Intense threefold from superior-middle descent: even the initiated gets no firm conviction in own-Śiva-ness — by ripening-order only, at body's-end, Śiva just.
From middle-intense, eager-for-Śiva becomes enjoyment-seeker; in initiation, knowledge-vessel — gained by yoga-practice, with this very body enjoying, at body's-end Śiva just.
sanskrit_cite: tīvrās tridhā utkṛṣṭamadhyāt śaktipātāt kṛtadīkṣāko 'pi svātmanaḥ śivatāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhapratipattiḥ bhavati pratipattiparipākakrameṇa tu dehānte śiva eva madhyamadhyāt tu śivatotsuko 'pi bhogaprepsuḥ bhavati iti tathaiva dīkṣāyāṃ jñānabhājanam sa ca yogābhyāsalabdham anenaiva dehena bhogaṃ bhuktvā dehānte śiva eva

lines: From the inferior-middle, through another body, enjoying, he reaches Śiva-hood — so.
sanskrit_cite: nikṛṣṭamadhyāt tu dehāntareṇa bhogaṃ bhuktvā śivatvam eti iti

lines: Middle too is threefold by desire-pronouncement: when desire leads, mildness — by Lord-mantra-yoga means, since desire there, since that yoga's end is release — hence its descent-nature.
sanskrit_cite: madhyas tu tridhā bhogotsukatā yadā pradhānabhūtā tadā mandatvaṃ pārameśvaramantrayogopāyatayā yatas tatra autsukyam pārameśamantrayogādeś ca yato mokṣaparyantatvam ataḥ śaktipātarūpatā

lines: Even within, by degree's triplicity — such the chief descent.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi tāratamyāt traividhyam ity eṣa mukhyaḥ śaktipātaḥ

lines: For Vaiṣṇavas-and-rest, like a king's grace — no release-ending: so no weighing here.
sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu rājānugrahavat na mokṣāntatā iti na iha vivecanam

lines: The Śiva-Power-abode, though, is everywhere — so said.
She is not most-supreme, but fierce, or fiercer: manifold the descent, split by manifold degrees.
Some Vaiṣṇava-standing, by samayyā-order, in the five streams, ripened — attains the six-and-a-half-scriptures' supreme authority;
others by leap-order, by infinite difference — some unsequential — so.

Hence lower-and-higher-doctrine-standing teachers, even at mere-mandala-seeing, are unqualified; the higher-standing teacher, by contrast, approves lower-and-higher-doctrine, from fullness — thus qualified-for-all.
sanskrit_cite: śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu sarvatra iti uktam sā paraṃ jyeṣṭhā na bhavati api tu ghorā ghoratarā vā sa eṣa śaktipāto vicitro 'pi tāratamyavaicitryāt bhidyate kaścid vaiṣṇavādisthaḥ samayyādikrameṇa srotaḥpañcake ca prāptaparipākaḥ sarvottīrṇabhagavatṣaḍardhaśāstraparamādhikāritām eti anyas tu ullaṅghanakrameṇa anantabhedena ko 'pi akramam iti ata eva adharādharaśāsanasthā guravo 'pi iha maṇḍalamātradarśane 'pi anadhikāriṇaḥ ūrdhvaśāsanasthas tu guruḥ adharādharaśāsanaṃ pratyuta prāṇayati pūrṇatvāt iti sarvādhikārī

lines: Here the guide, teacher, initiator, attractor — full-knowledge, just supreme: by him, initiation-and-rest cannot fail.
sanskrit_cite: sa ca daiśiko guruḥ ācāryo dīkṣakaḥ cumbakaḥ sa cāyaṃ pūrṇajñāna eva sarvottamaḥ tena vinā dīkṣādyasampatteḥ

lines: The yogi joined to fruit-eagerness: by means-teaching, able to give uninterrupted fruit; joined in knowledge gives release by proper means; desiring knowledge-fullness, many gurus he should make.
sanskrit_cite: yogī tu phalotsukasya yukto yadi upāyopadeśena avyavahitam eva phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ upāyopadeśena tu jñāne eva yukto mokṣe 'pi abhyupāyāt jñānapūrṇatākāṅkṣī ca bahūn api gurūn kuryāt

lines: By knowledge-grades supreme-and-rest, in them he stays; abandoning the full-knowledge-guru, only expiation stands.
sanskrit_cite: uttamottamādijñānabhedāpekṣayā teṣu varteta sampūrṇajñānagurutyāge tu prāyaścittam eva

lines: But he — silent, or speaking wrongly — why not abandon him? Never: from full-knowledge-ness, passion's absence is his.
Non-speech-and-rest would come from the disciple's side, by some unworthiness-untrustworthiness cause — so.
Hence in contemplation of him the disciple strives, not in his abandonment.
sanskrit_cite: nanu so 'pi abruvan viparītaṃ vā bruvan kiṃ na tyājyaḥ naiva iti brūmaḥ tasya hi pūrṇajñānatvāt eva rāgādyabhāva iti avacanādikaṃ śiṣyagatenaiva kenacit ayogyatvānāśvastatvādinā nimittena syāt iti tadupāsane yatanīyaṃ śiṣyeṇa na tattyāge

lines: Thus caused-by-grace power-descent independent indeed
from-dependence-on-act-and-rest-determinism.
sanskrit_cite: evam anugrahanimittaṃ śaktipāto nirapekṣa eva karmādiniyatyapekṣaṇāt

lines: Concealment — such the fruit of dependence: deep sorrow, delusion shared.
Like light-freedom's, the awakened one acts the fool; by heart he scorns his foolish act.
Likewise the fool performs awakened acts and scorns them too: his foolish act, even when done of the awakened, goes to destruction.
His awakened act, being scorned — from forbidden-conduct-form and self-suspicion — drowns him in sorrow-delusion mire.
Yet of arisen-power-descent concealment exists also: dependence on act-and-rest as before is prohibited there;
there too, from will-manifoldness, this body-only-sorrow-fruit — or in initiation-covenant-conduct-teacher-fire's service-condemnation-both, like before, of doctrine-abandoners like.
sanskrit_cite: tirobhāva iti tirobhāvo hi karmādyapekṣagāḍhaduḥkhamohabhāgitvaphalaḥ yathāhi prakāśasvātantryāt prabuddho 'pi mūḍhavat ceṣṭate hṛdayena ca mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ nindati tathā mūḍho 'pi prabuddhaceṣṭāṃ mantrārādhanādikāṃ kuryāt nindec ca yathā ca asya mūḍhaceṣṭā kriyamāṇāpi prabuddhasya dhvaṃsam eti tathā asya prabuddhaceṣṭā sā tu nindyamānā niṣiddhācaraṇarūpatvāt svayaṃ ca tayaiva viśaṅkamānatvāt enaṃ duḥkhamohapaṅke nimajjayati na tu utpannaśaktipātasya tirobhāvo 'sti atrāpi ca karmādyapekṣā pūrvavat niṣedhyā tatrāpi ca icchāvaicitryāt etad dehamātropabhogyaduḥkhaphalatvaṃ vā dīkṣāsamayacaryāgurudevāgnyādau sevānindanobhayaprasaktānām iva prāk śivaśāsanasthānāṃ tattyāginām iva

lines: Even so, from will-manifoldness, concealed — by self or by descent he joins, dead or through kinsman-grace's mouth:
duty-share committed in own self to the Supreme-Lord just — so the self, unmaimed, should see.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi icchāvaicitryāt tirobhūto 'pi svayaṃ vā śaktipātena yujyate mṛto vā bandhugurvādikṛpāmukhena ity evaṃ kṛtyabhāgitvaṃ svātmani anusaṃdadhat parameśvara eva iti na khaṇḍitam ātmānaṃ paśyet
